title: Snapchat now lets you share what you're listening to in real time | TechCrunch
summary: Snapchat is now letting users share the music they’re listening to in real time via a new feature in Snap Map, TechCrunch has exclusively learned. The new feature comes as social media platforms continue to embrace music discovery and sharing.
